title: crabsim model file
description: A crabsim model file. It holds the model only: a run's seed, length and warm-up are not part of it.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for editors. crabsim ignores it, keeps it when saving, and never needs the file it names to exist.

format_version.description: The format's version, 2. Version 1, with each instance's `successors` instead of a list of connections, isn't read any more.

description.description: What the model is, as a whole.

classes.description: The model's own classes, in any order. Each derives from a built-in class (Source, Station, Buffer, Drain, Conveyor, or MU for an MU class) or from another class here.

instances.description: The material-flow objects, in the order a run initialises them.

connections.description: The ways MUs pass from one instance to another, in any order: each says its own place in both orders it belongs to, so sorting the list changes nothing.

ClassFile.description: A class of the model's own, or, named like a built-in class and with no parent, this model's own values for that built-in class, which every class and instance built on it inherits.

name.description: Unique among classes. Source, Station, Buffer, Drain, Conveyor or MU makes it this model's own values for that built-in class.

parent.description: The class it derives from: Source, Station, Buffer, Drain, Conveyor, MU or another class in the file. Left out only on a class named like a built-in class, and required on every other.

attributes.description: Only the values this class changes from its parent.

Name.description: A name: not empty, and with no spaces at either end.

AttributesFile.description: The values a class or instance sets. Each applies to some built-in classes only, and anything left out is inherited.

interval.description: Source: the time between creating an MU and offering it on. 0 by default, which creates the next MU as soon as one leaves.

process_time.description: Station: the time it works on each MU. 0 by default, a dummy Station that takes no time.

failures.description: Any object: random failures. Left out, it never fails.

starting_mus.description: Station, Buffer: how many MUs it holds from the start of a run, at most its capacity, in the order they count as having entered. 0 by default.

capacity.description: Station, Buffer: how many MUs it holds. A Station's is a whole number from 1 to 10,000, and 1 by default: one machine working on that many MUs at once. A Buffer's is unlimited by default.

start.description: Station: when it begins work on its MUs. Individual by default.

dwelling_time.description: Buffer: how long each MU stays before it may leave, counted from its own entry. 0 by default.

exit_strategy.description: Buffer: which of the MUs whose dwelling time is over it passes on next. First in, first out by default.

histogram_bar_width.description: Buffer: how many MUs each of its fill histogram's 64 bars covers, from 1. Left out, it is automatic: one each, doubling whenever more MUs come than the bars reach. Set, the last bar collects everything beyond, such as 315 or more with a width of 5.

stop_freezes_dwelling.description: Buffer: whether an interruption freezes the dwelling time of the MUs dwelling in it, so they become ready later by its length. False by default: their dwelling time runs on.

dimensions.description: Any object: its size in metres and rotation in degrees. Visual only.

description.description: Any object: free text saying what it is. Visual only.

state_notes.description: Any object: the model's own note on what a state means for it, by state, shown beside crabsim's definition of the state. Only states its built-in class can be in, each note not empty. Inherited as a whole. Visual only.

distribution.description: Source, Station, Conveyor: which successor receives the MU it passes on (ADR 0016). Round robin by default. Inherited as a whole.

mu_class.description: Source: the MU class whose MUs it makes, `MU` or a class derived from it. `MU` by default.

mu_values.description: Source: its own values for the MUs it makes, changing its MU class's. Inherited as a whole.

length.description: MU class: its footprint's length along the way it travels, in metres. 0.6 by default.

width.description: MU class: its footprint's width across the way it travels, in metres, 0.4 by default. Conveyor: how wide it is, in metres, 0.6 by default: an MU wider than this doesn't fit.

booking_point.description: MU class: where its booking point is, as a share of its length from its front, 0 at the front and 1 at the rear. Where it is decides when it passes from one object to the next. 0.5 by default, its centre.

path.description: Conveyor: the line its MUs follow (ADR 0024), as segments from its position, heading along its rotation, each starting where the one before ends. Lengths are in plan, and the conveyor's length counts each in 3D, rise included. One straight of 5 m by default.

speed.description: Conveyor: how fast it moves its MUs, in metres per second, above 0. 0.5 by default.

gap.description: Conveyor: the least space between two MUs on it, in metres, 0 or more. 0 by default.

accumulating.description: Conveyor: whether MUs behind a stopped one close up and stop while the rest still move, true by default, or every MU stops as a whole when the first can't leave and they all start again together.

direction.description: Conveyor: which way its MUs travel along its path, "forward", from its first segment to its last, the default, or "backward". Its start, where MUs enter, is then the path's last point.

min_radius.description: Conveyor: the tightest bend its path may have, as a radius in metres. Unset by default: then only half its width, inside which its inner edge would fold.

max_incline.description: Conveyor: the steepest its path may climb or fall, in degrees. 30 by default.

Time.description: A time, written as crabsim's UI shows it: seconds, minutes and seconds, or hours, minutes and seconds, with days in front and a fraction of a second at the end. Such as "90", "1:30", "8:00:00", "2d 06:00:00", "3d" or "0:00:12.5".

FailuresValue.description: Failure profiles: a list of named ones, which are independent of each other, or, as older files have it, a single unnamed one, read as a list of one named "Failures".

stream.description: Its random-number stream within the object, 0 or more, unique there. Without one, its place in the list from 0.

time_basis.description: What counts down to its next failure. Simulation time by default.

availability.description: The share of time available, above 0 and below 1.

TimeBasisFile.description: The kind of time that counts down to a failure profile's next failure.

oneOf.description: All time counts, whatever the object is doing.
All time but paused, idle and blocked included.
Only time busy, once however many MUs are in work: a Station or Source only.

RepairTimeFile.description: How long a repair takes: exactly one of these.

oneOf.description: Normally distributed with this mean and standard deviation.
Erlang distributed with this mean and shape `k`.

FailuresFile.description: Random failures. The time between failures follows from the availability and the repair time.

availability.description: The share of time available, above 0 and below 1.

CapacityFile.description: A whole number from 1, or `"unlimited"`: it then takes every MU and grows as far as it's filled. -1 is read as unlimited too, and saved as `"unlimited"`.

oneOf.description: Each MU starts on entry, with its own process time.
Work begins when the Station is full, and its entrance stays closed until it is empty.
The MU that came in first.
The MU that came in last, as from a stack.

rotation_degrees.description: Around the vertical axis, 0 if left out.

StateNotesFile.description: A note per state, each left out if there is nothing to say.

holding.description: Buffer: it has MUs in it, none of which is kept from leaving.

forced_failure.description: Any object: Stopped's name before ADR 0020, still read.

receiving.description: Station, Buffer, Drain: a place reserved for an MU a conveyor is handing over.

DistributionFile.description: `"round_robin"`, each successor in turn, or weighted: the best-ranked successor that can take the MU, those ranking equal taking turns.

by.description: What each object is weighed by, resolved through inheritance. An object without it weighs 0, such as a Drain for process_time.

order.description: Which totals rank first: smallest by default.

rank.description: What a successor is ranked by: `route`, its best route onward to a Drain with itself included, by default, or `successor`, its own weight only.

drains.description: The Drains a route may end in. Left out, every Drain counts. A name that isn't a Drain is ignored, and validate_model warns about it.

MuValuesFile.description: A Source's own values for the MUs it makes, each changing its MU class's when set.

booking_point.description: A share of its length from its front, from 0 to 1.

SegmentFile.description: One piece of a conveyor's path: exactly one of a straight, an arc, a transition curve and a helix. Angles and turns are positive to the left, the way rotation turns, and negative to the right. A `rise` is the change in height over the segment in metres, negative falling.

straight.description: Straight on: its length in metres, or its length and rise.

length.description: Its length in plan, in metres.

radius.description: Its radius in plan, in metres, more than half the conveyor's width.

angle.description: How far it turns, in degrees, not 0: positive to the left.

transition.description: A clothoid, its bend changing evenly from the bend the segment before ended with, or straight for the first, to `to_radius`.

length.description: Its length in plan, in metres.

to_radius.description: The radius it eases to in metres, positive to the left, or "straight".

radius.description: Its radius in plan, in metres.

turns.description: How many times it turns, not 0: positive to the left.

rise.description: How far it climbs over its turns, in metres, not 0: negative falling. A flat turn is an arc.

oneOf.description: From the path's first segment to its last.
From the path's last segment to its first.

class.description: Source, Station, Buffer, Drain, Conveyor or a class in the file derived from one: not an MU class.

stream.description: Its stream: with a run's seed, it gives the instance's random numbers, so runs of two variants with the same seed draw the same numbers for it. Unique in the model. crabsim gives one when the instance is placed: changing it ends pairing with every earlier run.

position.description: The centre of its footprint, in metres. Visual only.

attributes.description: Only the values set on this instance. Anything else comes from its class.

z.description: Height above the floor, 0 if left out.

ConnectionFile.description: A connection from one instance to another. Moving along it takes no time.

from.description: The instance MUs leave, which can't be a Drain.

to.description: The instance MUs enter, which can't be a Source or `from` itself.

exit.description: Its place among the connections out of `from`, the order MUs are offered round-robin: 1 to n with no gaps or repeats.

entrance.description: Its place among the connections into `to`, 1 to n with no gaps or repeats. Nothing reads it yet, so it doesn't change results until an entrance rule does.

description.description: What the connection is, such as "via the lift".
